nodes.description: In Rtl1 knockout mice, fetal capillaries in the basal labyrinth become clogged and damaged, the labyrinth fails to expand, and the placenta is small, causing mid- to late-fetal lethality or late fetal growth retardation. This is the proposed placental contribution to fetal growth restriction in Temple syndrome.
